purpose: Acquire point-in-time source evidence and daily early-morning NBM station forecasts before model fitting or validation scoring
final_holdout: October-December 2025 remains inaccessible to this acquisition
station_mapping_status: Research candidates supported by retrieved rule place names and source directory; each historical event still needs station and final NWS label reconciliation before promotion
availability_evidence: Archive exact object LastModified and ETag from NOAA public S3, matched conditional GET responses and raw byte ranges; do not equate runtime with availability
availability_limit: Object storage timestamp is stronger evidence than guessed release lag but does not independently prove historical public-access permissions or original dissemination time
window_warning: TXN is the product's 18-hour extrema guidance, not a midnight-to-midnight contract label; TMP is a 3-hourly forecast, not a continuously sampled daily maximum
method: Reuse known station offsets only as a request hint, validate exact station/runtime/version/columns, recover by full-object GET when hint fails; preserve missing requests
cost_bound: At most one listed NBS object per development day, eight short ranges with full-object fallback; stop if free disk falls below 20 GiB
